variables.name: base/500
variables.description:
Base neutral, ladder step 500 of 950  |  content - text, icons, borders
Cool  -> cool/500  #627289  tone 48  vs white 4.90:1
Warm  -> warm/500  #846D56  tone 48  vs white 4.88:1
The name is the step: base/500 always resolves to step 500 of the active theme ramp.
Pairing rule - +400 = 3:1 non-text, +500 = AA 4.5:1, +700 = AAA 7:1. Holds in both themes.
